findings.failureScenario: Consumers searching for a RightKit updater can select the wrong public package because @rightkit/update and @rightkit/updates differ only by a trailing s while both describe update behavior. The singular package is a per-repository dependency-update CLI (right-update), whereas the plural package is the app runtime policy helper consumed by Tauri apps; installing one when the other is intended produces a package with the wrong surface, and the singular package has no release record in INDEX.md.
findings.action: Rename unreleased @rightkit/update to an explicit repository or dependency updater name before publication, or publish an explicit package alias, and cross-link both READMEs with a one-line scope distinction. Keep @rightkit/updates reserved for app runtime update policy.
findings.verificationMethod: source-review of both package manifests, entry-point READMEs, Tauri consumer guidance, and INDEX release records
